visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white sleeveless dress with large bows on the shoulders, dances energetically behind a circular white display stand. The stand features bottles of light-colored products and is centered around a large potted olive tree. The background is a brightly lit, modern retail space with white walls and a wood-paneled ceiling. (2) A sharp cut shows a large crowd of people, mostly young women in casual attire and masks, standing behind a black rope barrier, holding up smartphones to record. (3) The woman from phase one is now in the foreground, holding a white handheld microphone with branding, speaking directly to the camera with an expressive face. (4) A series of quick cuts follow, showing a close-up of a clear plastic pump bottle with a greenish label, the woman walking through a store entrance under a 'ROOTON' sign, and her gesturing toward a white shelf containing various 'ALPHA ERGUEN' branded bottles. (5) She stands in front of a large circular mirror mounted on a white wall, taking a selfie while smiling. (6) She interacts with a wall display featuring small rectangular cards and a white classical sculpture of a woman holding a vessel. She picks a card and holds up two small sample packets (one white, one green) close to the lens. (7) She points to a wall with large printed text and a QR code, then moves to a sleek golden sink area where she pumps liquid soap and rubs her hands together to create a rich white foam under a running faucet. (8) The woman stands on a small elevated platform, speaking into the microphone to the gathered crowd. A second woman in a white dress stands beside her, also holding a microphone. (9) The video ends with a group photo of the woman surrounded by many smiling fans holding branded bags and products.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main female creator, 1 female staff/interviewer, approximately 33 audience members/passers-by.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian woman with long, dark, wavy hair styled with a white bow. She wears a white sleeveless dress with bow straps and a button-down front.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A clean, minimalist pop-up store environment featuring white tiered displays, a real olive tree center-piece, classical Greek-style columns and statues, and product shelves with warm accent lighting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Energetic electronic pop music begins with a syncopated synth beat and female vocal 'woo' accents. No narration. (2) A sharp transition SFX triggers the entry of a female narrator speaking Mandarin with a high pitch and excited tone. The BGM ducks slightly to favor the speech. (3) A series of short digital 'pop' and 'whoosh' SFX occur at approximately 0:08 and 0:12, marking transitions between descriptive segments. Music continues with a steady 128 BPM pulse. (4) Distinct sound of a mechanical pump followed by the splash and continuous rush of water into a sink occurs around 0:44, mixed prominently with the narration. (5) Acoustic atmosphere shifts as distant crowd cheering and ambient chatter become audible behind the primary narrator's voice, indicating a public event setting. (6) Music intensity increases for the final five seconds, ending on a bright chord with the narrator's cheerful closing greeting and collective laughter.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Introduction -> Store Walkthrough -> Interactive Features -> Testing -> Community Interaction
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the ROOTON pop-up store at Eslite Spectrum Nanxi by showcasing its aesthetic design, product line, interactive activities (cards/psychological tests), and the creator's personal endorsement through a fan meet-up event.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator specifically mentions being invited by the brand, shows specific products, explains store promotions, and uses a branded microphone.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-quality promotional vlog with strong social engagement, utilizing rapid editing and on-screen subtitles to maintain viewer interest in a retail event.
